name: Compress PDF
short: Shrink a PDF to 50 KB–1 MB for any form upload. Text stays sharp.
h1: Compress PDF Online — Reduce PDF Size Free
metaTitle: Compress PDF Online Free – Reduce PDF Size | Documently
metaDescription: Compress PDF to 100 KB, 200 KB or any target size right in your browser. Free, no upload, no signup. Scans shrink a lot while text stays sharp.
answer: To compress a PDF, open it here, pick a target such as 100 KB or 200 KB, and tap Compress. In our tests, a 5.16 MB six-page scan came down to 69 KB in 2.1 seconds. Text stays sharp and the file is never uploaded.
keyFacts: Documently Compress PDF is a free in-browser tool that reduces a PDF to a target size such as 50 KB, 100 KB, 200 KB, 500 KB or 1 MB. The compressor runs Ghostscript compiled to WebAssembly, so the PDF is processed on the phone or computer and is never uploaded. Typed text and vector lines stay sharp, because only scanned images are resampled, starting at 150 DPI and stepping down to 40 DPI if needed. In our tests on a 6-page scanned PDF of 5.16 MB, we measured 44 KB for the 50 KB target in 1.4 seconds, 69 KB for 100 KB in 2.1 seconds, 154 KB for 200 KB in 2.6 seconds, 284 KB for 500 KB in 7.0 seconds and 877 KB for 1 MB in 3.7 seconds. The engine is about 11 MB and downloads once, on first use. Pick the exact limit printed on your form, compress, and check the size on the result card before you upload.
intro: Most form portals reject a PDF the moment it crosses their size limit, and a phone scan of even two pages can easily be 3–5 MB. This PDF size reducer gets your file under the limit without a laptop or an app. Choose an exact target in KB or a quality level, and the tool keeps the text crisp while it shrinks the images and scans that make the file heavy.
steps: Select or drop your PDF into the upload box.
Choose Target size and tap a chip such as 100 KB or 200 KB, or switch to Quality level and pick Best quality, Balanced or Smallest size.
Turn on Black & white if your PDF is a scanned document and colour is not required.
Tap Compress and wait a few seconds; the first time, the compression engine (about 11 MB) downloads once.
Check the new size shown on the result card and tap Download.

sections.heading: When do you need to reduce PDF size?
paragraphs: Almost every online application in India has a PDF limit, and it is usually small. Limits differ by portal — NTA's JEE Main 2027 bulletin, for example, asks for supporting PDFs of 50–300 KB — so check the exact limit printed on your form.
Common situations where a smaller PDF saves the day:
bullets: Uploading marksheets, caste or income certificates to a scholarship or university admission portal.
Attaching a resume or experience letter to a job application that rejects files over 1 MB.
Sending bank KYC documents or a signed form by email when the attachment keeps failing.
Sharing a scanned PDF on WhatsApp or uploading it over a slow Jio or Airtel 4G connection.

sections.heading: Why won't my PDF go below 100 KB?
paragraphs: Compression only removes weight from images and scans. Typed text and vector graphics are already compact, so a 40-page text-only PDF may not shrink much, while scans shrink a lot: in our tests a 6-page, 5.16 MB scan came down to 877 KB at the 1 MB target, an 83% cut.

In Target size mode the tool lowers image resolution step by step, from 150 DPI down to 40 DPI, until the file fits. Going from 300 to 100 DPI alone cuts the pixel count by about 89%. If even 40 DPI is not enough, you get the smallest size that was possible instead of an unreadable file. If your PDF is already under the target, you get the original back untouched.
bullets: Turn on Black & white for scans; grayscale pages are much lighter than colour.
Split the PDF and upload only the pages the portal actually asks for.
Rescan at a lower resolution if the original scan was made at 600 DPI.

sections.heading: Tips so the portal accepts your file
bullets: Zoom into the result before uploading; if stamps or small print look smudged, pick a larger target or Balanced quality.
Some portals count 1 KB as 1024 bytes and others as 1000 bytes, so aim a little under the limit (for example 190 KB for a 200 KB cap).
Remove the password from a protected PDF first; locked files cannot be compressed.
Keep the file name simple, without spaces or symbols, as some older portals reject them.

sections.heading: How does compression work without uploading your file?
paragraphs: The tool runs Ghostscript, a long-established PDF engine, compiled to WebAssembly so it works inside your browser. Your PDF is read and rewritten on your own phone or computer, and the result is saved straight to your device.
Nothing is sent to a server. We only record anonymous counts such as which tool was used and the file size, never the file itself or its name.

faqs.q: How can I compress a PDF to 100 KB on my phone?
faqs.a: Open this page in Chrome or Safari, select your PDF, choose Target size and tap the 100 KB chip, then tap Compress. The work happens on your phone, so it is free, needs no app or signup, and your document is never uploaded anywhere.

faqs.q: Will compressing my PDF make the text blurry?
faqs.a: No. Typed text and vector graphics are left untouched, so they stay sharp at any setting. Only images and scanned pages are reduced in resolution. If a scanned page looks soft after compression, choose a larger target size or the Balanced quality level.

faqs.q: Why is my compressed PDF still bigger than the target?
faqs.a: Some files cannot reach very small targets without becoming unreadable, for example long documents or dense colour scans. The tool tries resolutions down to 40 DPI and then shows the smallest size it could reach. Try Black & white, or split the PDF and upload fewer pages.

faqs.q: Is it safe to compress Aadhaar or marksheet PDFs here?
faqs.a: Yes. The PDF is processed entirely inside your browser and never leaves your device. We do not store, see or upload your documents. Only an anonymous count of the tool used and the file size is recorded, with no file names or content.

faqs.q: Can I compress a password-protected PDF?
faqs.a: Not directly. A locked PDF has to be unlocked first, using the password, in a PDF reader or the app that created it. Save an unlocked copy, then open that copy here and compress it like any other file.

faqs.q: Why does the tool download something the first time?
faqs.a: The compression engine is about 11 MB and is loaded only when you use this tool, so other pages stay fast. It downloads once, after which compression runs offline-style on your device. On 4G this usually takes a few seconds.

sections.heading: When do you need a photo under a fixed KB size?
paragraphs: Online forms set strict limits because they store lakhs of uploads. Exam registrations, job applications, university admissions, scholarship forms and bank KYC all commonly ask for photos between 10 KB and 200 KB.
bullets: A passport-style photo for a recruitment or admission form that must be under 50 KB.
Scanned ID cards, caste certificates or fee receipts saved as JPG for a portal.
Product or document photos you need to send quickly on a slow 4G connection.

sections.heading: How the tool hits an exact KB target
paragraphs: First it searches for the highest JPEG quality that still fits under your target, testing settings in a binary search instead of guessing. Only if the lowest sensible quality is still too large does it reduce the pixel dimensions, so your photo keeps as much detail as possible.
The output is always JPG. Results are kept under the target whether a portal counts 1 KB as 1000 bytes or 1024 bytes, so a 50 KB file here is at most 50,000 bytes and will pass either check.

sections.heading: Common mistakes that get photos rejected
bullets: Going too small: many portals also have a minimum, such as 10 or 20 KB. Check both limits before you compress.
Starting from a WhatsApp-forwarded image: WhatsApp already recompresses photos, so they turn blurry faster. Use the original from your gallery.
Very low targets for large photos: JPEG quality below about 40 shows visible blocky patches. For 10–20 KB, crop to just the face or document first.
Uploading HEIC from an iPhone: it is not supported yet. Change Settings → Camera → Formats → Most Compatible, or take a screenshot of the photo and use that.
Wrong dimensions: if the form also asks for exact pixels, use Resize Image or the exam photo tool instead.

sections.heading: Is it private? How it works on your phone
paragraphs: Compression uses your browser's built-in image engine, so the photos are decoded, re-encoded and saved on your own phone or computer. They are never uploaded to any server.
That also makes it fast on a weak signal, because only the page loads over the internet, not your files. We record only anonymous usage counts like the tool used and file size.

faqs.q: How do I reduce photo size to 50 KB?
faqs.a: Select your photo, tap the 50 KB target and tap Compress. The tool finds the best JPEG quality that fits under 50 KB and reduces dimensions only if necessary. The result is a JPG ready for upload, created in your browser without sending the photo anywhere.

faqs.q: Can I compress a photo to 20 KB without losing clarity?
faqs.a: Usually yes for a passport-style photo, because a face crop needs few pixels. For a full phone photo, 20 KB means real detail loss. Crop the image to just the face or document first, then compress, and the result will look much sharper.

faqs.q: Why does the portal say my file is too large when it shows 50 KB?
faqs.a: Some systems count 1 KB as 1024 bytes and others as 1000. A file shown as 50 KB on one device may be 51 KB elsewhere. Files made here stay under the target in both counts, so they pass either rule.

faqs.q: Does it work with iPhone HEIC photos?
faqs.a: Not yet. On your iPhone, go to Settings → Camera → Formats and choose Most Compatible so new photos save as JPG. For an existing HEIC photo, take a screenshot of it and compress the screenshot instead.

faqs.q: Can I compress many photos at once?
faqs.a: Yes, you can add up to 30 images in one batch. All of them are compressed to the same target size, and you can download each JPG. Everything runs on your device, so large batches may take a little longer on older phones.

faqs.q: Is the image compressor free and without watermark?
faqs.a: Yes. It is completely free, needs no signup or login, and adds no watermark or logo to your photos. The files never leave your device, so there is nothing for us to keep or delete afterwards.

sections.heading: When do you need to resize an image to exact dimensions?
bullets: Recruitment and exam forms that list photo and signature sizes in pixels, like 200 × 230 px.
Admission forms and certificates that give sizes in cm, such as 3.5 × 4.5 cm.
Passport-style photos for ID cards, hostel forms or bank account opening.
Shrinking a 4000 × 3000 pixel phone photo so it loads quickly on a website or email.

sections.heading: Pixels, cm and DPI explained in one minute
paragraphs: Pixels are what the screen and the portal actually check. Centimetres only make sense together with DPI (dots per inch), which says how many pixels fit into each inch when printed.
The formula is pixels = cm ÷ 2.54 × DPI, because 1 inch is 2.54 cm. So 3.5 cm at 200 DPI is 276 pixels, and 4.5 cm at 200 DPI is 354 pixels. At 300 DPI the same photo would be 413 × 531 pixels.
The same maths works in reverse: a 300 × 100 pixel signature at 200 DPI prints at about 3.8 × 1.3 cm.
The DPI you pick is written into the JPG header, which some portals read when they check the size in cm.

sections.heading: Tips and common rejection reasons
bullets: Stretched faces: turning off Keep proportions here centre-crops instead of stretching, so faces never look squashed. Check the crop still shows your full face.
File too small: some portals reject files under 10 or 20 KB. Set a minimum KB and the tool safely pads the JPG to reach it without changing the picture.
File too large: set a maximum KB and the tool lowers JPEG quality until it fits.
Upscaling a tiny image makes it blurry. Start from the original camera photo, not a WhatsApp forward or a screenshot.
Photo in PNG or WebP? The output is always JPG, the format most application forms ask for.

sections.heading: Private by design: nothing is uploaded
paragraphs: Resizing, cropping and re-encoding all happen in your browser using its built-in canvas. Your photo stays on your phone or computer, and the result is saved directly to your downloads.
We keep only anonymous counts, like which tool was used and the file size. No images, names or personal details are ever stored.

faqs.q: How do I resize a photo to 3.5 × 4.5 cm?
faqs.a: Choose centimetres, enter 3.5 for width and 4.5 for height, pick 200 or 300 DPI, and tap Resize. At 200 DPI you get 276 × 354 pixels; at 300 DPI, 413 × 531 pixels. Check which DPI your form asks for, if any.

faqs.q: How do I resize an image to exact pixels and under 50 KB?
faqs.a: Enter the width and height in pixels, set the maximum KB to 50, and tap Resize. The tool first sets the exact dimensions, then adjusts JPEG quality to stay under 50 KB. Add a minimum KB too if the form has a lower limit.

faqs.q: Will my photo get stretched if I change both width and height?
faqs.a: No. With Keep proportions on, the other side adjusts automatically. If you turn it off to get an exact shape, the tool centre-crops the extra area instead of stretching, so your face or signature keeps its natural proportions.

faqs.q: What DPI should I choose for an online form?
faqs.a: Use the DPI the form mentions. If it gives only pixels, DPI does not change how the photo looks on screen, so any value works. If it gives cm without DPI, 200 or 300 DPI are common choices for clear passport-style photos.

faqs.q: Why is my resized photo bigger in KB after making it smaller?
faqs.a: File size depends on JPEG quality and image detail, not only on dimensions. A heavily compressed original can grow when saved at higher quality. Set a maximum KB value and the tool will keep the output under it.

Blurry signature: sign with a black or dark blue pen on plain white paper and photograph it in daylight, not under a yellow bulb.
Using a WhatsApp-forwarded photo: it is already recompressed and looks soft. Use the original camera file.
Wrong dates or details on the notice: requirements change each year, so match your preset's verified date to the current notification.

faqs.q: My photo is under the minimum KB. How do I increase its size?

Sideways phone photos are handled for you: the rotation saved by the camera (EXIF) is respected.

Admit cards, certificates and e-statements often need to be a JPG to upload, print at a shop, or share on WhatsApp. This tool turns each PDF page into a clear JPG at the resolution you choose, and the conversion happens on your phone or computer, so your document stays private.
steps: Select or drop your PDF into the upload box.
Choose the image quality: 100, 150 or 300 DPI.
Tap Convert and wait while each page is rendered.
Download pages one by one, or all of them as a single ZIP.

sections.heading: When do you need a PDF as JPG images?
bullets: A form asks for a certificate or ID as JPG, but you downloaded it as a PDF, for example from DigiLocker.
Sharing one page of a document on WhatsApp, where images open instantly without a PDF reader.
Using a single page, such as a photo ID or caste certificate, inside another document or presentation.
Printing at a cyber cafe or photo shop that prefers image files.

sections.heading: Which DPI should you pick?
paragraphs: DPI decides how many pixels each page gets. An A4 page becomes about 827 × 1169 pixels at 100 DPI, 1240 × 1754 pixels at 150 DPI and 2480 × 3508 pixels at 300 DPI.

Use 100 DPI for quick sharing and small uploads, 150 DPI for a good balance of clarity and size, and 300 DPI when you need to print or zoom into fine text. A 300 DPI image has nine times the pixels of a 100 DPI one, so the file is much larger.
For WhatsApp, 150 DPI is plenty, because WhatsApp recompresses images sent as photos anyway.

sections.heading: Tips and common problems
bullets: Image too big for the portal? Convert at 100 or 150 DPI, then use Compress Image to hit an exact KB target.
Text looking soft at 100 DPI? Small print, like a roll number on an admit card, needs 150 DPI or more to stay readable.
Need just one page? Download that single JPG instead of the whole ZIP.
Need a fixed pixel size? Run the JPG through Resize Image afterwards.
On a phone, a ZIP may need the Files app to open; downloading pages one by one saves them straight to your gallery or downloads.
Password-protected PDFs must be unlocked before they can be converted.

sections.heading: How the conversion stays on your device
paragraphs: Pages are drawn by a PDF renderer that runs in your browser, the same kind used to display PDFs on screen, and then saved as JPG. The PDF is never uploaded, which matters for documents like Aadhaar, PAN or bank statements.
We only keep anonymous counts, such as which tool was used and file size, never files or their names.

faqs.q: How do I convert a PDF to JPG on my phone?
faqs.a: Open this page in your mobile browser, select the PDF, pick 150 DPI for a good balance, and tap Convert. Each page becomes a JPG that you can download individually or as a ZIP. No app or signup is needed, and the PDF stays on your phone.

faqs.q: How do I convert only one page of a PDF to JPG?
faqs.a: Convert the PDF, then download only the page you need from the results instead of the ZIP. If the PDF is very long, you can first use Split PDF to pull out that page, then convert just that small file.

faqs.q: Which DPI gives the clearest image?
faqs.a: 300 DPI is the sharpest, giving about 2480 × 3508 pixels for an A4 page, which is ideal for printing. For uploads and WhatsApp, 150 DPI is usually clear enough and produces much smaller files.

faqs.q: Can I convert a DigiLocker PDF to JPG?
faqs.a: Yes, if the PDF opens normally without a password. Select it here and convert as usual. If the file asks for a password when opened, unlock it first with the password in a PDF reader and save an unlocked copy.

faqs.q: Is there a page limit for converting PDF to JPG?
faqs.a: No fixed page limit. Every page is rendered on your device, so very long PDFs at 300 DPI need more memory and time. On older phones, convert at 100 or 150 DPI or split the PDF into smaller parts first.

Bank KYC or loan paperwork where address proof, ID and income proof must go together.
Keeping all pages of a form that you scanned in parts as one clean document.

paragraphs: Put the documents in the sequence the form lists them. If it says nothing, a safe order is: application or cover page, ID proof, educational certificates from the highest qualification down, then experience or other supporting documents.
Reviewers often check dozens of applications in a sitting, so a predictable order helps yours get processed without queries.

sections.heading: Private merging, right in your browser
paragraphs: The files are read and joined on your own phone or computer. Pages are copied as they are, without re-compressing, so text and scans look exactly like the originals.

faqs.q: How do I merge PDF files on my phone?

faqs.q: Will merging reduce the quality of my documents?

faqs.q: My merged PDF is too large for the portal. What now?

faqs.q: Can I add JPG photos to a merged PDF?

Choose Pick pages and type ranges such as 1-3, 5, 8-end, or choose Every page separately.
Tap Split to create the new PDFs.
Download a single result directly, or all results as one ZIP.

sections.heading: When do you need to split a PDF?

You need only the last three months of a long bank statement for KYC or a visa file.
An answer key, prospectus or notification is huge and you need only the relevant pages.
Getting a PDF under a size limit by dropping blank or extra pages.
Sharing only the relevant pages of a statement, so you hand over less personal data.

paragraphs: Each comma-separated part becomes its own PDF. Typing 1-3, 5, 8-end gives three files: pages 1 to 3, page 5 alone, and page 8 through to the last page.

Pages keep their original size and orientation, so a landscape page stays landscape in its new file. To rejoin parts in a different order later, use Merge PDF on the split files.

Results are still too big? Pass the split file through Compress PDF.
Need the pages as images instead? Use PDF to JPG.

sections.heading: How splitting works in your browser
paragraphs: The tool reads your PDF on your own device and copies the chosen pages into new files without re-compressing them, so text and scans look exactly the same as before.

faqs.q: How do I extract specific pages from a PDF?

faqs.q: How do I save each page of a PDF as a separate file?
faqs.a: Choose Every page separately and tap Split. A 10-page PDF becomes 10 single-page PDFs, which download together as one ZIP. You can then upload each page into a different slot on your form.

faqs.q: What does 8-end mean in the page range?
faqs.a: It means from page 8 to the last page of the document, whatever that number is. It saves you from checking the total page count and makes sure no pages at the end are missed.

faqs.q: Does splitting a PDF reduce its quality?
faqs.a: No. The selected pages are copied exactly as they are, without re-compression, so text and scanned images keep their original sharpness. The new files are smaller only because they contain fewer pages.

faqs.q: How do I open the ZIP file on my phone?

This tool turns the pages you choose to the right direction without re-compressing anything, so the file quality stays the same. It runs entirely in your browser and works on any phone.
steps: Select or drop your PDF into the upload box.
Choose the direction: 90° right, 180° or 90° left.
Apply it to all pages, or type specific pages such as 2, 4-6.
Tap Rotate and download the corrected PDF.

sections.heading: When do you need to rotate PDF pages?
bullets: A scanned certificate or marksheet came out sideways from a phone scanning app.
A landscape page, like a table or a fee chart, is stuck in portrait inside a document.
You merged PDFs from different sources and a few pages face the wrong way.
An upside-down page from a feeder scanner at a cyber cafe.
paragraphs: Phone scanning apps guess orientation from how the phone is tilted, so a page shot with the phone lying flat often comes out sideways. Rotating fixes the file in seconds without scanning again.

sections.heading: Why rotation here is lossless
paragraphs: Every PDF page stores a rotation setting that tells viewers which way to display it. This tool changes only that setting; it does not redraw or re-encode the page content.
So text stays selectable, scans keep their exact pixels, and the file size stays almost the same. You can rotate as many times as you like without losing quality.
By contrast, turning pages into images and back to PDF would re-compress every scan and usually make the file bigger or blurrier.

sections.heading: Tips for getting it right first time
bullets: Note which pages are wrong in a PDF viewer first, then type only those, for example 3, 7-8.
90° right turns the top of the page towards the right; if a page reads bottom-to-top, that is usually the fix.
For upside-down pages, use 180°.
If photos came out sideways when making a PDF, rotate the finished PDF here rather than re-taking photos.
After rotating, use Compress PDF if the file also needs to be smaller.
Rotation works only in 90° steps; it cannot straighten a page that was scanned slightly tilted.

sections.heading: Privacy: your PDF stays on your device
paragraphs: The PDF is opened, adjusted and saved inside your browser. It is never uploaded to a server, so confidential documents like bank statements or offer letters remain private.
Because nothing is uploaded, even a long PDF is ready as fast as your phone can read it, whatever your network speed.
We count only anonymous usage, such as the tool used and the file size, never content or file names.

faqs.q: How do I rotate only one page in a PDF?

faqs.q: Does rotating a PDF reduce quality?
faqs.a: No. The tool changes only each page's rotation setting and does not re-encode the content, so text, images and scans keep their exact quality. The file size stays practically the same as the original.

faqs.q: How do I permanently rotate a PDF so it stays fixed?
faqs.a: Rotate the pages here and download the new file. The rotation is saved inside the PDF itself, so it displays correctly in any viewer, on any phone or computer, and when you upload it to a portal.

faqs.q: Can I rotate different pages in different directions?
faqs.a: Yes, in two passes. First rotate one set of pages, for example 2, 4-6 by 90° right, and download. Then open that new file and rotate the other pages in the direction they need.

faqs.q: Can I rotate a PDF on my phone?

sections.heading: When do you need to remove a PDF password?
bullets: An upload portal rejects your e-Aadhaar or bank statement because it is password-protected.

paragraphs: An open password (also called a user password) stops anyone opening the file without it. To unlock this kind, you must type that password; the tool cannot guess or recover it.

faqs.q: Can this tool unlock a PDF if I forgot the password?

Removing the table, bedsheet or fingers around a photographed document before making a PDF.
